critical_code_review_comments: OfflineGate web behavior RCA: @react-native-community/netinfo v12 web impl subscribes to navigator.connection 'change' when the Network Information API exists (Chromium) and ONLY falls back to window online/offline events otherwise. Playwright's CDP set_offline fires window events but not the connection change event, so standard offline emulation never triggers the gate — this is a test-tooling limitation, NOT an app bug. Dispatching the connection 'change' event manually proved the gate works end-to-end (shows offline UI, retry button, hides on reconnect).
No deprecated Expo packages in package.json (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch).
Deploy fix artifacts verified on disk: yarn.lock present, package-lock.json absent, packageManager=yarn@1.22.22, root .gitignore clean of .env rules.

rca_of_issue: No regressions found. One investigation note: initial offline-gate simulation appeared to fail, RCA'd to Playwright CDP offline emulation not firing the NetworkInformation 'change' event that netinfo v12's web implementation subscribes to in Chromium (navigator.connection exists → window online/offline listeners are never registered). Firing the event manually confirmed the gate logic, modal UI, retry button, and recovery path all work correctly. Native (EAS build) uses the netinfo native module, unaffected by this web-only tooling quirk.
